properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge, both response valids are cleared; pre-reset presentations are not suppressed.
A blocked data response preserves valid, data and last across the edge unless reset cancels it.
A blocked status response preserves valid and every status field independently of data readiness, unless reset cancels it.

Every valid data presentation is justified by accepted input history in frame and byte order. The first eight bytes are preserved; padding is zero and permitted only after input completion. Checks are bounded to 63 outstanding tracked frames.

Every valid status describes the next completed accepted frame, with exact original length, length clamped to 4..8, and correct padding and truncation flags. Status consumption is tracked independently of data consumption.

Every valid last indication matches the adjusted frame boundary, including streaming prefixes and early completion of the eight-byte truncated output. After 128 consecutive ready-high, reset-low, no-offer edges, the bounded tracked epoch has no incomplete input or outstanding data/status response.
